8201.html:
8201 pipīlá m. 'ant' RV., °laka- m. 'large black ant' ChUp., pipī́likā- f. 'small red ant' AV., pīlaka- m. 'ant' lex. 2. *piphīla-. 3. *pippīla-. 4. *pipphīla-. 5. *pippīḍa-. 6. *pilīla-. [Variety of MIA. and NIA. forms for 'ant' may be due partly to its (unknown) nonAryan origin (EWA ii 285), partly to contamination with kīṭá- and kŕ̥mi-, but mainly to some sort of taboo for a noxious insect. Although there appear to be six main types, not all NIA. forms can be grouped exactly under them]
    1. Pa. pipīlikā-, pipillikā- f. 'ant', Pk. pipīliā- f., °lia- m., pivīliā- f., Wg. pīmilī́k, pilī́k, Gaw. pilo, Tor. pel f.; — dissim. of p — p (Wackernagel AiGr i Nachträge 158) or X kīṭá-: Pa. kipillaka- m., °likā- f., Aś. kq. aṁbā-kipilikā nom. pl., top. -kapīlika, rdh. -kapilika 'a kind of ant', S. kiulī f., kĩulī f. (X kŕ̥mi- ?); L. kavīlī f. 'small red ant'; N. kamilo, (< *kãwilo rather than < karmín-).
    2. Kal.urt. phīwilík 'ant'; L. pehlā m. 'large black ant', °lī f. 'small red ant' (< *pahĭ̄l-), awāṇ. pḕlā, °lī; WPah.śeu. priùli 'ant', l.rudh. priv̀lli (X *priśu- ?), khaś. h.rudh. biùli.
    3. Or. pipīḷi 'ant'; — P. piplīhī f. (cf. Pk. forms with -p- in 1 ab.).
    4. Dm. phipilī́, phempilī 'ant'.
    5. OB. piṁpaḍā 'ant', MB. pĩpīṛā, B. pĩp(i)ṛā, pipiṛā, Or. pimpuṛi, Mth. pipṛī; H. pipṛā m. 'large black ant', °ṛī f. 'small red ant'; — Pk. pippaḍā- f. 'a kind of ant' (cf. *pippa-²); A. piparā 'ant' (paruwā 'ant' < *pawarā < *papaḍa- ?).
    6. Kal.rumb. pilī́lyΛk 'ant', Kho. pilíli, Bshk. pilíl, Phal. pilī́lu m.; — Sh. phĭlīli̯ f.
    Addenda: pipīlá-. 1. WPah.kṭg. phímpəṛi f. 'butterfly', J. fimfṛi f.; — kṭg. kimbli, khímbli f. 'ant' with dissimilation of ph-p to kh-b as bh-ph to g-ph in †*bāhuṣphara-.
    5. *pippīḍa-: A. also pipãrā (AFD 211), OA. pimparā 'ant'.

4822 *cimb 'pinch'. [Cf. *cibba-, *capp-]
    Bshk. ičimik 'blink'; S. cimṭo m. 'tongs'; P. cambaṛnā, cimmaṛnā 'to copulate', cimṭā m. 'tongs'; Ku. cim 'pinch', cimṭā 'pincers', cimoṭi 'nip with the nails'; N. cim 'closing the eyes', cimlanu 'to blink', cimṭanu, cimoṭ° 'to pinch', cimṭā 'pincers'; B. cimṭā 'to pinch', sb. 'tongs'; Or. cimuṭibā 'to pinch', cimuṭā 'pinching, tongs'; H. cimaṭnā 'to embrace closely', cimṭā, cyū̃ṭā m. 'pincers'; G. cĩboḷvũ 'to pinch the ear', cimṭɔ m. 'tongs', camṭɔ m. 'hard pinch'; M. cĩbṇẽ 'to pinch, squeeze', cĩbaḷṇẽ, cĩbaṭṇẽ, cimaṭṇẽ 'to pinch', cimṭā m. 'pinch, pincers'.
    Addenda: *cimb- [In sense 'blink' ~ Drav. DED 2097]

5227 jiyā́, jyā́-, j(i)yākā́- f. 'bowstring' RV. 2. jīvā- f. lex. (sajīva- 'having a bowstring' Śiś.).
    1. Pa. jiyā-, jyā- f., NiDoc. jiya, Ash. žī, Wg. Kt. ǰī, Pr. žī, Kal. rumb. Tor. ǰī, Si. diya; — Wg. Dm. gī with g from guṇá- ? — Kho. zī ← Pers. zih.
    2. Pk. jīvā-, jīā- f.; — ext. -ḍa-: P. jeuṛī f 'string', °ṛā m. 'rope'; Ku. jyūṛī 'cord', jyoṛo 'rope, snake'; N. jiuri 'rope'; A. zõr 'bowstring', zɔrī 'string'; Bi. jaurī f. 'rope'; Mth. jauri 'hemp or grass rope'; H. jeuṛī f. 'string, snake', °ṛā m. 'rope'.
    sajja-; *grīvājyā-, *pratijya-.
    Addenda: jiyā́-. 2. G. jevrī f. 'bowstring'.
